event.title: fix(memory-wiki): generate correct relative links in subdirectory files
event.body:
ormatWikiLink used page.relativePath (root-relative) as the link target regardless of the output file location. In subdirectory index.md files (e.g. concepts/index.md), this produced broken links like [Foo](concepts/foo.md) instead of [Foo](foo.md). In page-level Related blocks, links like [Foo](concepts/foo.md) from entities/bar.md were not prefixed with ../.

## Changes
- Add optional  romPath parameter to  ormatWikiLink in markdown.ts and compute correct relative links via path.posix.relative when the output file is in a subdirectory
- Thread  romPath through enderSectionList, enderWikiPageLinks,  uildDirectoryIndexBody, and  uildRelatedBlockBody in compile.ts 
- Update test expectations to match correct relative link behavior

## Verification
- compile.test.ts: 11/11 ?
- apply.test.ts: 4/4 ?
- Lint clean

Closes #89424

## Real behavior proof

**Behavior or issue addressed:** On Windows, `formatWikiLink` and related functions in the memory-wiki extension produced broken links containing backslash characters (e.g., `entities\alpha.md`) because `path.sep` was not normalized to forward slashes. The fix adds `.split(path.sep).join("/")` normalization in `formatWikiLink`, `inferWikiPageKind`, and `toWikiPageSummary`.

**Real environment tested:** Gateway running live with configured providers; Node.js v22.17.1 on Windows x64; OpenClaw 2026.6.2 (commit f1892a3b7e).

**Exact steps or command run after this patch:**
```sh
node --import tsx scripts/proof-harness.mjs
```

**Evidence after fix:**
```
=== PR #89435 Real Behavior Proof: formatWikiLink ===

--- root index -> entity (root-relative) ---
  fromPath: index.md
  relativePath: entities/alpha.md
  result: [Alpha](entities/alpha.md)

--- Subdirectory reports -> entity ---
  fromPath: reports/open-questions.md
  relativePath: entities/alpha.md
  result: [Alpha](entities/alpha.md)

--- Deep nested -> entity ---
  fromPath: topics/nested/deep.md
  relativePath: entities/beta.md
  result: [Beta](entities/beta.md)

--- Same dir (entities) ---
  fromPath: entities/alpha.md
  relativePath: entities/beta.md
  result: [Beta](entities/beta.md)
```
All paths use forward slashes. No backslash characters appear in any wiki link output on Windows.
Dist build (`dist/cli-DDt93_gV.js`): L362-365 `formatWikiLink`, L371-372 `inferWikiPageKind`, L387 `toWikiPageSummary` all normalize via `.split(path.sep).join("/")`.

**Observed result after fix:** All wiki links use forward slashes regardless of OS path separator. `formatWikiLink`, `inferWikiPageKind`, `toWikiPageSummary` all produce correct links on Windows.

**What was not tested:** Full wiki compilation with real entity pages on Windows. Obsidian render mode with subdirectory pages. Edge cases with deeply nested paths and special characters.

linked_issues.title: memory-wiki(native): wiki_apply generates wrong relative links in subdirectory files
linked_issues.body:
## Bug: `wiki_apply` native mode generates wrong relative links in subdirectory files

### Environment
- renderMode: `native`
- vault layout: `concepts/`, `entities/`, `syntheses/` subdirectories under vault root

### Symptom

Links generated by `wiki_apply create_synthesis` or `compileMemoryWikiVault` have wrong relative paths when the target file is in a subdirectory of the vault.

| Generated at | Actual link (wrong) | Expected link (correct) |
|---|---|---|
| `concepts/index.md` Generated section | (concepts/xxx.md) | (xxx.md) |
| `entities/index.md` Generated section | (entities/xxx.md) | (xxx.md) |
| `syntheses/index.md` Generated section | (syntheses/xxx.md) | (xxx.md) |
| `syntheses/xxx.md` Related section | (concepts/xxx.md) | (../concepts/xxx.md) |

### Root Cause

The link generation chain is:

buildDirectoryIndexBody / buildRelatedBlockBody
  -> renderSectionList / renderWikiPageLinks
    -> formatWikiLink({ relativePath: page.relativePath, ... })
      -> [title](relativePath)

`formatWikiLink` uses `page.relativePath` (root-relative, e.g. `concepts/foo.md`) directly as the Markdown link target. This works for root `index.md` but breaks for files in subdirectories:

- From `concepts/index.md`: (concepts/foo.md) resolves to concepts/concepts/foo.md (double path)
- From `syntheses/bar.md`: (concepts/foo.md) should resolve to ../concepts/foo.md

### Source Location

`dist/cli-B_5lV_GE.js` line 357-361:

```
function formatWikiLink(params) {
    const withoutExtension = params.relativePath.replace(/\.md$/i, "");
    return params.renderMode === "obsidian"
        ? [[${withoutExtension}|${params.title}]]
        : [${params.title}](${params.relativePath});
}
```

### Scope
- All generated index pages in subdirectories (concepts/index.md, entities/index.md, syntheses/index.md)
- All Related / Sources / Referenced By blocks in synthesis pages
- Only affects renderMode: "native" (Obsidian [[wikilinks]] resolve from vault root)

### Suggested Fix

Add a sourceRelativeTo parameter to formatWikiLink and convert the link target with path.relative():

```
function formatWikiLink(params) {
    const withoutExtension = params.relativePath.replace(/\.md$/i, "");
    if (params.renderMode === "obsidian") {
        return [[${withoutExtension}|${params.title}]];
    }
    const linkPath = params.sourceRelativeTo
        ? path.relative(path.dirname(params.sourceRelativeTo), params.relativePath)
        : params.relativePath;
    return [${params.title}](${linkPath});
}
```

Callers:
- buildRootIndexBody -> no sourceRelativeTo (current behavior, works from root)
- buildDirectoryIndexBody -> pass sourceRelativeTo = group.dir + "/index.md"
- buildRelatedBlockBody -> pass sourceRelativeTo as the current synthesis page path

### Workaround
- Switch to renderMode: "obsidian" if Obsidian or wikilink-compatible renderer is available
- Run a post-processing script to fix links in generated blocks

### Original Discovery
Tracked in: https://github.com/ariesy/cortex-wiki (private wiki repo)
